title: Add "Add to Cart" Button on Product Listing Page

stack.frontend: React 18 + Redux Toolkit + react-redux + react-toastify + axios
stack.note: Backend POST /api/cart/add is an EXTERNAL, pre-existing endpoint; no backend service is designed here (overrides the Spring Boot wording in the generic arch docs).

components.name: index
components.responsibility: Entry point: mounts React root, wraps App in Redux Provider, imports react-toastify CSS.

components.name: App
components.responsibility: Composes Header, ProductList and ToastContainer; hydrates guest cart on mount.

components.name: CartIcon
components.responsibility: Shows cart icon with live item-count badge from selectCartCount; aria-live polite so count updates are announced (AC4).

components.name: ProductList
components.responsibility: Responsive CSS-grid listing (1 col mobile, 2 tablet, 3-4 desktop); renders a ProductCard per product.

components.name: ProductCard
components.responsibility: Renders product name/price/image via React text nodes (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML) and an AddToCartButton on every card (AC1).

components.name: AddToCartButton
components.responsibility: Stateful button: idle/in-stock, adding, added, out-of-stock (disabled), error; dispatches addToCart thunk; fires toast on success/failure; disabled while in flight to prevent double submit.

components.name: productsData
components.responsibility: Static sample product catalogue (id, name, price, imageUrl, inStock) used by ProductList until a catalogue API is supplied.

components.name: store
components.responsibility: configureStore with cart and auth reducers; devTools disabled in production.

components.name: cartSlice
components.responsibility: State {items, count, statusByProduct, error}; addToCart async thunk (guest -> cartStorage, authenticated -> cartService); hydrateGuestCart reducer; selectors selectCartCount, selectAddStatus(productId).

components.name: authSlice
components.responsibility: Holds isAuthenticated boolean (assumed contract; default false). Token/session handled outside cart code.

components.name: cartService
components.responsibility: axios instance (baseURL from process.env.REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL, withCredentials, timeout); addItem(productId, quantity) -> POST /api/cart/add; maps errors to safe user messages.

components.name: cartStorage
components.responsibility: Guest cart persistence in localStorage key guest_cart with schema validation and try/catch around JSON.parse/setItem; falls back to empty cart on corrupt data.

components.name: tests
components.responsibility: Unit tests for button states: in stock, out of stock, adding, success (Added), error (AC9).

endpoints.access_rule: Authenticated users only (session cookie or bearer token managed by auth layer). Guests never call it; guest adds stay in localStorage.

responses.200: { items: [...], count: number } updated cart; UI updates counter and shows success feedback
responses.400: Invalid productId/quantity; UI shows generic 'Could not add item' error state
responses.409: Out of stock / insufficient inventory; button becomes 'Out of Stock'
responses.5xx: Server error; button error state with retry, generic message, no stack trace

1.note: Button rendered on every product card.

3.note: Button state 'Added ✓' for ~2s plus react-toastify toast 'Item added to cart!'. Wording assumed (open question).

4.note: Count derived from Redux state; updates on fulfilled thunk.

5.note: inStock=false -> disabled button labelled 'Out of Stock', no dispatch.

6.note: isAuthenticated=false -> items persisted to localStorage guest_cart.

9.note: Jest + Testing Library tests for in-stock, out-of-stock, success states.

10.note: Responsive CSS (mobile-first media queries, min touch target 44px); verified with viewport tests and manual desktop/mobile check.

button_states.added: Label 'Added ✓', disabled briefly (~2s) then reverts to idle; toast 'Item added to cart!'.
button_states.out_of_stock: Label 'Out of Stock', disabled, aria-disabled=true, no dispatch on click.
button_states.error: Label 'Try again', enabled; toast with generic 'Could not add item. Please try again.'.

responsive_approach: Mobile-first CSS in src/styles.css: product grid via CSS grid (1 col <600px, 2 cols 600-900px, 3-4 cols >900px); header collapses spacing on mobile; buttons full-width on cards with min height 44px; toast container top-center on mobile, top-right on desktop; viewport meta tag in public/index.html.
auth_determination: Assumption: an auth slice exposes isAuthenticated (boolean, default false) set by the host app's login flow. Cart code reads it only via selector and never stores or reads tokens itself.
assumptions: Stack override: frontend-only React/Redux Toolkit design; backend is external.

POST /api/cart/add request body {productId, quantity}; success returns 200 with {items, count}; errors 400/401/409/5xx as listed. Auth via httpOnly session cookie (withCredentials) or bearer token injected by a host-app interceptor.
Logged-in vs guest determined by auth.isAuthenticated (spec open question left it unspecified).
Toast wording 'Item added to cart!' and button 'Added ✓' used together (spec gives them as examples).
Product catalogue comes from a static sample file until a catalogue API is specified; each product has an inStock boolean.
Epic/priority/issue-type discrepancies in spec open_questions do not affect design.
state/memory.json is empty; no learned patterns applied.
security_controls: XSS-safe rendering: all product data rendered as React text nodes; dangerouslySetInnerHTML is forbidden; image URLs restricted to http(s) scheme.

Input validation: productId must match /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/ and quantity must be an integer 1..99 (utils/validators.js) before any storage write or API call; invalid input rejected without request.
No secrets in code: no API keys, tokens or passwords committed; configuration only via environment.
API base URL read from process.env.REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL (no hardcoded host); only non-secret values may use the REACT_APP_ prefix since they are bundled into client JS.

Guest cart stored in localStorage key guest_cart with schema validation on read (array of {productId, quantity} with validated fields, max 100 entries) and try/catch around JSON.parse/setItem/quota errors; corrupt data is discarded.

Auth token handling: cart code never reads, writes or persists auth tokens in localStorage/sessionStorage; prefer httpOnly secure cookie session; any token is injected in memory by a host-app axios interceptor.
No PII in logs: no console logging of cart contents, user ids, tokens or response bodies; errors logged by category only.
No stack traces or internal details shown to the user: errors mapped to generic messages; raw server messages never rendered.

CSRF/credentials: axios withCredentials=true only to the configured allowed origin; rely on SameSite cookies and a server-side CSRF token header (X-CSRF-Token) if the backend requires it; CORS allow-list is a backend responsibility.
Request hardening: axios timeout (10s), button disabled while request in flight to prevent duplicate submission, HTTPS-only base URL enforced in production.
Dependency hygiene: lockfile-pinned versions and npm audit in CI.
AuthZ: endpoint called only when isAuthenticated is true; server remains the authority for authN/authZ and inventory checks, client state is not trusted.

threats.threat: A03 Injection / XSS via product name or description rendered in cards
threats.mitigation: React escaping, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, URL scheme allow-list for images, CSP header recommended on hosting.

threats.threat: A03 Injection via tampered productId/quantity (DOM edit or crafted guest cart)
threats.mitigation: Client-side validators plus schema validation on localStorage reads; server must revalidate (documented assumption).

threats.threat: A02 Sensitive data exposure: tokens or PII persisted in localStorage
threats.mitigation: Cart storage holds only productId and quantity; auth tokens never stored by cart code; httpOnly cookies preferred.

threats.threat: A05 Security misconfiguration: secrets or API host hardcoded in bundle
threats.mitigation: REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL via environment only; .env not committed; no secrets in REACT_APP_ vars.

threats.threat: A01 Broken access control: manipulated isAuthenticated flag to sync another user's cart
threats.mitigation: Backend derives user from session/token, never from client-supplied user id; request body contains only productId and quantity.

threats.threat: A04 Insecure design: price or stock manipulation from client
threats.mitigation: Client sends only productId/quantity; server computes price and checks inventory (409 handled in UI).

threats.threat: A09 Logging failures / information leakage via console or error messages
threats.mitigation: No PII logging; generic user-facing error messages; no stack traces rendered.
SameSite cookies, CSRF token header when required by backend, CORS origin allow-list server-side.

threats.threat: A06 Vulnerable and outdated npm dependencies
threats.mitigation: Lockfile, npm audit in CI, minimal dependency set.

threats.threat: Abuse via rapid repeated add clicks (DoS / duplicate adds)
threats.mitigation: Button disabled while adding, axios timeout, server-side rate limiting.

threats.threat: Corrupt or oversized localStorage guest cart crashing the app
threats.mitigation: try/catch on parse, schema validation, max 100 entries, fallback to empty cart.
